results.title: Hackers used DeepSeek AI to steal 2,000 defence documents, then made one big mistake
results.description: A cybersecurity investigation by CloudSEK has exposed the operations of Silent Lynx, a suspected cyber espionage group targeting government infrastructure across Central Asia. Researchers uncovered stolen defence documents, compromised railway systems and a DeepSeek-based AI agent used to support hacking activities. Here’s how the operation worked and what investigators discovered.
